# Psalm 46 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 46:1 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** For-the-choirmaster. Of-the-sons of-Korah. Upon Alamoth. A-song.
- **LOGOS:** For the choirmaster. Of the Sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. A song.
- **PNEUMA:** For the music director. A song of the descendants of Korah, to be sung by soprano voices.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 46:5 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** A-river — its-streams gladden the-city of-God, the-holy [dwelling] of-the-tabernacles of-the-Most-High.
- **LOGOS:** There is a river whose streams make glad the city of God, the holy habitation of the Most High.
- **PNEUMA:** A river brings joy to the city of our God, the sacred home of the Most High.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 46:10 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** He-makes-wars-cease to-the-end of-the-earth; the-bow He-breaks and-cuts the-spear; the-chariots He-burns with-fire.
- **LOGOS:** He makes wars cease to the end of the earth; He breaks the bow and shatters the spear; He burns the chariots with fire.
- **PNEUMA:** He causes wars to end throughout the earth. He breaks the bow and snaps the spear; He burns the shields with fire.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 46:6 (overlap: 6%)

- **EMET:** God [is] in-her-midst; she-shall-not be-moved. God helps-her at-the-turning of-the-morning.
- **LOGOS:** God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved; God will help her when morning dawns.
- **PNEUMA:** God dwells in that city; it cannot be destroyed. From the very break of day, God will protect it.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 46:8 (overlap: 6%)

- **EMET:** YHWH of-hosts [is] with-us; a-fortress for-us [is] the-God of-Jacob. Selah.
- **LOGOS:** The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress. Selah.
- **PNEUMA:** The LORD of Heaven's Armies is here among us; the God of Jacob is our fortress. Pause and reflect.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 46:3 (overlap: 7%)

- **EMET:** Therefore we-will-not fear when-the-earth changes, and-when-the-mountains totter in-the-heart of-the-seas.
- **LOGOS:** Therefore we will not fear though the earth gives way, though the mountains be moved into the heart of the sea,
- **PNEUMA:** So we will not fear when earthquakes come and the mountains crumble into the sea.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
